title: A flat point occurs in a supplied finite-type integer approximation
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and let $M$ be an $S$-module with its restricted $R$-action [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Let $U$ be the maximum of their universes and lift $R,S,M$ to $U$ by the canonical $\mathrm{ULift}$ equivalences. Suppose a nonempty directed preorder $\Lambda$ in $U$ indexes ring diagrams $A_i\to B_i$ and abelian groups $D_i$, with $B_i$-module structures, compatible ring cocones to the lifted $R,S$, and a compatible additive cocone to the lifted $M$. Assume these three cocones are colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], the ring squares commute, and both the module transitions and module cocone maps are semilinear for the top-ring maps. Assume $A_i$ is finite type over $\mathbf Z$, $B_i$ is finite type over $A_i$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], $D_i$ is finite over $B_i$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and the canonical transition maps $B_i\otimes_{A_i}A_j\to B_j$ and $B_j\otimes_{B_i}D_i\to D_j$ are isomorphisms for $i\le j$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. For any prime $q$ of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] such that $M_q$ is flat over $R$, there is $i$ such that $(D_i)_{q_i}$ is flat over $A_i$, with the restricted action, where $q_i$ is the contraction of $q$ along $B_i\to\mathrm{ULift}(S)\to S$. No final tensor equivalence, finite presentation of the limit, or open flat locus is assumed or concluded.

source.place: Theorem Tag 00RC (theorem-openness-flatness), first reduction paragraph: the localized approximation satisfies Tag 00QX and Tag 00R6 gives a stage flat at the contracted prime; also Tag 00R1 (lemma-limit-module-finite-presentation)

proof.text: Use finite type over the Noetherian ring of integers to prove that every A_i is Noetherian. Equip B_i with the supplied A_i-algebra structure and use finite type once more to prove B_i Noetherian. This is proved explicitly in Lean.

Apply lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-approximation-localized-diagrams to the supplied three colimits, scalar compatibilities, the just-proved Noetherian stage hypotheses, module finiteness, and the two transition tensor equivalences. Obtain Noetherian local diagrams and their localization and module comparisons. This construction assumes no flatness and selects no flat stage.

Equip the localized module colimit with the R-action restricted along the displayed localization map. Transport the given R-flatness of M_q through the supplied R-linear equivalence, then apply Module.flat_iff_of_isLocalization to obtain flatness over the localized base colimit. Apply RingTheory.exists_flat_stage to the localized diagrams and all their compatibility and tensor comparisons.

At the chosen stage restrict scalars through the supplied prime-localization map A_i to the localized base stage. Module.flat_iff_of_isLocalization yields A_i-flatness of the localized diagram module. Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv transports this to the original D_i localized at the contraction of q. Both transports and all scalar-tower instances are written in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_flat_integer_approximation_stage_at_prime
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) (M : Type w)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower R S M] :
    let R' := ULift.{max u v w} R
    let S' := ULift.{max u v w} S
    let M' := ULift.{max u v w} M
    letI : Algebra R' S' := ULift.algebra' R S'
    ∀
    {Λ : Type (max u v w)} [Preorder Λ] [Nonempty Λ] [IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)]
    (A B : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{max u v w}) (η : A ⟶ B)
      (π : A ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (CommRingCat.of R'))
      (κ : B ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (CommRingCat.of S'))
      (D : Λ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w})
      (ν : D ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of M'))
    [∀ i : Λ, Module (B.obj i) (D.obj i)]
    (hmodel :
      -- (1) the three colimits, compatible with `R' → S'` and the module actions
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of R') π)) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of S') κ)) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (AddCommGrpCat.of M') ν)) ∧
      (∀ i, η.app i ≫ κ.app i = π.app i ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R' S')) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j) (y : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
        (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom (y • x) =
          (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom y • (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom x) ∧
      (∀ i (y : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
        (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M') (ν.app i)) (y • x) =
          (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of S') (κ.app i)) y •
            (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M') (ν.app i)) x) ∧
      -- (2) finiteness of the stages
      (∀ i, Algebra.FiniteType ℤ (A.obj i)) ∧
      (∀ i, letI := (η.app i).hom.toAlgebra; Algebra.FiniteType (A.obj i) (B.obj i)) ∧
      (∀ i, Module.Finite (B.obj i) (D.obj i)) ∧
      -- (3) transition base changes
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j),
        letI := (η.app i).hom.toAlgebra
        letI := (A.map (homOfLE h)).hom.toAlgebra
        ∃ e : B.obj i ⊗[A.obj i] A.obj j ≃+* B.obj j,
          ∀ (x : B.obj i) (y : A.obj j),
            e (x ⊗ₜ[A.obj i] y) = (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom x * (η.app j).hom y) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j),
        letI := (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom.toAlgebra
        ∃ e : B.obj j ⊗[B.obj i] D.obj i ≃ₗ[B.obj j] D.obj j,
          ∀ (y : B.obj j) (x : D.obj i),
            e (y ⊗ₜ[B.obj i] x) = y • (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom x))
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S)
    (hq : Module.Flat R (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl M)),
    ∃ i : Λ,
      letI : Algebra (A.obj i) (B.obj i) := (η.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      letI : Module (A.obj i) (D.obj i) := Module.compHom (D.obj i) (η.app i).hom
      letI : IsScalarTower (A.obj i) (B.obj i) (D.obj i) :=
        IsScalarTower.of_compHom _ _ _
      Module.Flat (A.obj i)
        (LocalizedModule
          (q.asIdeal.comap (ULift.ringEquiv.toRingHom.comp (κ.app i).hom)).primeCompl
          (D.obj i))
